findings.title: Self-protection continues after changed circumstances
findings.claim: The focus predicate of self-protective guarding remains active within the condition for the better Hereafter reward; when a wider supplied pattern moves from fear toward settled authority, the guarding reads as a practice that continues after relief and power.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 12:57:7:1 contacts the exact target surface at 24:55, whose supplied relation moves from fear to establishment and security and explicitly parallels Yusuf's worldly authority. That contact extends the self-protection carried by the focus predicate across a changed station and makes the recipient qualification operational under success.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see sakınmayı as an active way of carrying authority, rather than a label attached only to danger.
findings.containment: The ordinary claim that the Hereafter reward is better for believers who guard themselves remains primary. The 24:55 row is a contextual parallel with target Arabic but no target morphology; this does not equate taqwa with power, assert that every authority transition is righteous, or claim a surah-wide system.
